method: candidate lines proposed by corridor detection; identity decided from printed address runs
why_not_one_block_off: PRINTED NAME. 'AVENUE O 1/2' is lettered vertically inside the roadway I measured on both plates - sheet 87 at native x~1150 (east side of view 1, west side of view 2) and sheet 95 at native x~2140 (east side of view 2, west side of view 3). HUNDRED-BLOCK BREAK. On BOTH sheets Ave O 1/2 is the 1700/1800 break. Sheet 87: the column WEST of it reads 1701 1703 1705 1707 1709 1711 1713 1715 1717 1719 1721 1723 along 41ST ST and 1702 1704 ... 1724 along 42ND ST (quarters N.W. 59 / N.E. 58), and the column EAST of it reads 1801 1803 1805 1807 1809 1811 1813 1815 1817 1819 1821 1823 / 1802 1804 ... 1824. Sheet 95: the column WEST of it reads the same 1701 1703 ... 1723 / 1702 1704 ... 1724 along 42ND and 43RD ST (quarters N.W. 58 / N.E. 57) and the column EAST of it reads 1801 1803 ... 1823 / 1802 1804 ... 1824 (S.W. 58 / S.E. 57). Same 1700-block west face and 1800-block east face on both plates. ONE BLOCK WEST EXCLUDED. That corridor is lettered 'AVENUE O' on both plates (sheet 87 centre native ~151, hard against the plate's west border with sheet 86 printed in the margin; sheet 95 centre native 1140.2, fully drawn) and it is the 1600/1700 break, not the 1700/1800 break - on sheet 95 the column west of Ave O reads 1621 1623 / 1622 1624, and the entire 1701-1724 run lies BETWEEN Ave O and Ave O 1/2 on both sheets. ONE BLOCK EAST EXCLUDED. That corridor is lettered 'AVENUE P.' on both plates (sheet 87 centre native 2151.6, sheet 95 centre native 3137.8) and it is the 1800/1900 break - on sheet 87 the column east of Ave P reads 1901 1903 1905 / 1902 1904 1906, so the 1801-1824 run lies between Ave O 1/2 and Ave P and Ave P cannot be the 1700/1800 line. NEAR-EQUAL-NATIVE-X TRAP, EXPLICITLY REJECTED. Measured avenue centres at mid-sheet: sheet 87 O=~151, O 1/2=1149.8, P=2151.6, P 1/2=3148.1 (keymap O, O 1/2, P, P 1/2); sheet 95 N 1/2=~140, O=1140.2, O 1/2=2140.2, P=3137.8 (keymap N 1/2, O, O 1/2, P). The two plates are offset by very nearly one full block, so sheet 87's Ave O 1/2 (1149.8) sits only 9.6 px from sheet 95's Ave O (1140.2), and sheet 87's Ave P (2151.6) only 11.4 px from sheet 95's Ave O 1/2 (2140.2). Matching by similar native x - or by proximity in the current mosaic, which carries the same error - would pair O 1/2 with O and shear this row by a full block, about 990 px. Only the lettering and the 1700/1800 versus 1600/1700 address runs decide it. CORROBORATION. All three avenues the two plates share give the same plate-to-plate x shift: Ave O 1140.2-151.2 = +989.0, Ave O 1/2 2140.2-1149.8 = +990.4, Ave P 3137.8-2151.6 = +986.2. Spread 4.2 px against a one-block scale of ~990 px. The internal lattices agree too (sheet 87: O to O 1/2 = 998.6, O 1/2 to P = 1001.8, P to P 1/2 = 996.5; sheet 95: O to O 1/2 = 1000.0, O 1/2 to P = 997.6). Drafted roadway width for Ave O 1/2 is 210.4 native px on sheet 87 and 209.9 on sheet 95, matching the 70' printed beside it; the mid-block alleys measure ~59-61 px and are printed '20'' (sheet 95 alley faces 608.5/667.5, 1612/1673, 2609.5/2669), so no alley was mistaken for an avenue. Stacking confirmed: sheet 87's bottom margin prints '95', sheet 95's top margin prints '87', and 42ND ST is the shared seam. NOTE ON THE RED MARKER AND CANDIDATES. The red line in each crop is only the crop centre (native 832 / 1664 / 2495) and lands mid-block on both plates. The offered candidates (87: 752/1750/2749, 95: 2603/1562/522) are likewise not lettered avenues. The reported values are roadway centrelines - the midpoint of the two facing block lines - measured against the native pixel grid the green ruler labels. MEASUREMENT CONVENTION AND ITS LIMIT. Centrelines were measured in seven y bands from y=600 to y=3400, fitted linearly and evaluated at the sheet's vertical mid-height y=1949. Sheet 87's Ave O 1/2 is drawn the full height and gave all seven bands with a clean +0.0044 px/row drift and sub-pixel residuals. Sheet 95's Ave O 1/2 has drafted block casings only in the upper third of the plate (below 43RD ST the outlot quarters are open and unsubdivided), so its centre is measured directly only at y=800 (2139.80) and y=1200 (2139.93); the reported 2140.2 carries that essentially untilted line to mid-sheet, a change of 0.3 px. Reading both plates instead in the bands adjacent to the shared 42ND ST seam gives 87 O 1/2 = 1156.2 and 95 O 1/2 = 2139.8, a shift of +983.6 rather than +990.4; that ~7 px is the honest uncertainty on this control, and it is well below the one-block scale that matters. Ave P, which is drawn the full height on both plates, is the tightest independent check and gives +986.2, between the two.
